notes.title: Roxy 3 Year Anniversary Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]Main Game:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Text Dialogue Increased by approximately 30%
[*] Minor Optimization
[*] Various Bug Fixes
[*] Music Now Fades in at the start of a stage
[*] Fixed a bug where pausing the game while loading a level would stop the level from loading
[*] Ending Cutscene: Fixed a bug with some of the Rolling animations, Improved firework VFX
[*] New Client Icon
[*] Added one new secret hat to the overworld & one achievement for collecting it.
[*] Fixed a rendering issue with Daring Dom's hat on some levels
[*] Fixed a bug where secret hats occasionally played the collection audio twice upon being collected.
[*] The Halloween hat can now be accessed sooner.
[/list]

[h1]Roxy[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Jump Effects
[*] New Bounce Effects
[*] New Landing Effects
[*] Adjusted falling animation, it is now more accurate to Roxy's hitbox
[*] Roxy's walk/run animations now sync slightly faster from idle to better suit the actual movement.
[*] Added a camera shake deceleration after charging which syncs to the charge deceleration
[*] Roxy can now turn approximately 20% faster while charging 
[*] Roxy now immediately stops after a roll, removing the deceleration
[*] Roxy Now Wears Custom outfits during cutscenes
[*] Improved climbing animations
[*] Decreased bounce sound audio by 30%
[*] Modified Jump Audio
[*] Switching to First Person camera is now 30% faster
[/list]

[h1]Props, Interactable objects and Hazards[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Gem Collection Effects
[*] Crystals: New Aura, New Coloring
[*] Shrubs: New collision VFX, New Sound Effects
[*] Lighted Plants: New Light Animations
[*] Breaking Platform: New Destruction Effects
[*] Pendulum Trees: New Trails, New Aura, New Hit Effects
[*] Water: New Splash Effects, Altered color
[*] Foxes: Improved Walk Animations
[*] New Teleportation Effects for Donna & Ryan
[*] Fire Hydrants: New Water VFX, New Sounds
[*] Lava: New Splash Effects
[*] Moveable/Push-able Objects have had their audio levels adjusted and the times at which they play their sounds in order to better represent the actions within the game
[*] Collision Effects now spawn at the actual collision location rather than the player's location
[*] New NPC Interaction Sound
[*] Cauldrons: Improved smoke VFX
[*] Mimic Chests: Now run 25% faster, decreased line of sight range
[*] Lowered vehicle engine sounds by 30%
[*] Fixed a bug where shrubs would continuously activate even when the player was already dead
[*] Ghoulish Graz: Added a spooky aura
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes hazards would play their damage sound twice upon player collision
[*] Teleporter Bush: New Interaction VFX
[*] Teleporters: New activation VFX
[*] Teleporters: New Aura VFX
[/list]

[h2]Patrolling Guards[/h2]
[list]
[*] New footstep sounds
[*] Adjusted volume levels and frequencies
[*] Better player detection which accounts for obstacles in their line of sight
[*] Adjusted chasing AI: fixing a bug where they would immediately stop as soon as they lost the player's line of sight.
[*] Decreased cone of vision
[/list]

[h2]Treasure Chest[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted collision sizes
[*] Treasure chests now have a prompt to be opened rather than being opened automatically upon collision.
[*] New Chest Opening Sound
[/list]

[h2]Ladders[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Completely reworked climbing mechanics making it easier to climb on them as well as removing some bugs when approaching them from the sides.
[/list]

[h2]Bouncing Platforms[/h2]
[list]
[*] Previously: The first bounce was half height and all future bounces were full height.
[*] Now: Whenever the jump button is being held, the height will be at maximum, otherwise it will be at a lower height. Height values also adjusted
[/list]

[h1]Minigames[/h1]
[list]
[*] Rabbit Chase: New Capture Effects
[*] New Item Gathering VFX
[*] Mini-bosses: New Evil Skull Aura, New VFX when Donna casts her enchantments
[*] New Stunned Boss Aura
[*] Rabbits: New Hop Dust
[*] Item Collection Canvas is now larger
[*] Quest Timer Canvas is now larger
[*] New Interact Prompt
[*] Modified Texture on Glowing Pipes
[*] Adjusted object cameras on Witch Trial minigames to have better views at the objects
[*] Ryan Race: New Win & Start Race Sounds
[*] Improved Bush Collision Sounds
[*] Falling Hoops Sections: Added a banner that would appear after it has been completed to indicate it has been finished.
[*] Improved Rabbit Burrow & Un-burrow sounds
[*] Post Minigame text can now be skipped
[*] Triggering a minigame will no longer override the current checkpoint. Failing or completing the minigame will now revert the spawn to the current checkpoint rather than the minigame location.
[*] Fixed a stat tracking bug when replaying bosses.
[/list]

[h2]Target & Bowling Minigames[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upon failure, Roxy will automatically be teleported back to the start to make trying again simpler & faster.
[*] Added a banner that would appear after it has been completed to indicate it has been finished.
[*] Fixed a bug where they would sometimes appear even after completed.
[*] New Bowling Failure & Victory sound.
[*] Race Tracks: New Colors on Targets & Rings, Redesigned Progress Canvas, Added sparkle effects to targets, Adjusted various respawn positions
[*] Bowling Arrows: New Lighting
[/list]

[h2]Spell Books[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Page Gather VFX
[*] New Page Aura VFX
[*] New Book Aura
[*] New VFX created when pages spawn
[*] New VFX created when pages are de-spawned over time
[*] New Rotating Spell book Object is created when the trial is complete and will now be present each time the level is loaded when the trial is already complete
[*] Decreased Aura audio by 20%
[*] Page Hitbox size increased by 10%
[/list]

[h1]Game Settings & UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Settings Menu Dropdowns Redesigned for better legibility
[*] Controls can now be rebound
[*] Pause Menu redesigned
[*] Pause Menu now displays whether or not the secret hat has been found in the current level
[*] Added a restart from checkpoint option to the pause menu
[*] First Person camera sensitivity is now adjusted with the camera sensitivity settings.
[*] Added a separate toggle for inverting the first person camera.
[*] Sliders on all menus adjusted for better legibility
[*] Fixed a bug where the gamepad may still vibrate in some situations despite being disabled in the settings menu
[*] Completely redesigned the main menu
[*] Fixed a bug where volume levels weren't always being saved correctly
[*] Guidebook: Completely Redesigned
[/list]

[h2]Spawn Stone (checkpoints)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved colors on the current activated spawn stone
[*] Spawn stones now have their colors deactivated when a new checkpoint is activated
[*] New Spawn Stone/Checkpoint Activation Effect
[/list]

[h2]Hat Shop & Beauty Salon[/h2]
[list]
[*] Renamed
[*] Adjusted visuals/layout
[*] Added the ability to cycle through the options using the gamepad triggers
[*] Menu navigation now scrolls faster
[*] The Hat shop can now be accessed earlier in the game
[*] Hat Shop: Added a missing image for Secret Hat 33
[*] Modified the Hat Shop Cutscene.
[*] When collecting a hat in the overworld, the hat shop now automatically updates.
[*] Fixed some audio issues. 
[*] Auto-scroll speed increased drastically.
[/list]

[h1]Level Specific[/h1]
[h2]City[/h2]
[list]
[*] ATMS now shoot out coins (added effect to add a bit more life & chaos to the world)
[*] Paradise Park: Adjust lamp positions, Score the Big One - New Victory Effects, Improved intro cutscene, Adjusted Teleporter Locations, Optimized level, Moved some props around, Adjusted Race Track Item Positions, Race Track: Timer 3 seconds longer, Retrieve the Magic Scroll: Adjusted some dialogue
[*] Charming Chopper: New Rocket Explosion Effects, New Truck Explosion Effects, New Helicopter Explosion Effect. Rocket trails now linger after the rocket is destroyed. Adjusted prop locations
[*] Manic Machines: New Truck: Palette, Traffic Cone & Road Barrier Explosions, New Magical Aura around park, Fixed a bug where trucks would occasionally stop following the player during chase sequences, improved intro cutscene, Fixed an audio bug on the intro cutscene, Fixed a bug which caused Roxy's shadow to be cast through the bridge and onto the water. Slightly adjusted position of collectable objects in Tricky Trev's Challenge. Adjusted a few gem locations, Adjusted Various Prop Locations, Added additional props in various areas
[*] Riveting Rooftops: New Wandering Spirit VFX near end area, Reduced Bloom levels, Trevor's Rooftop Race: The Flag pole can no longer be climbed, Steal the Magic Potions: Adjusted dialogue
[*] Stunning Streets: Adjusted some tall grass locations in the park, Improved intro cutscene, Fixed a bug where potted plants couldn't be pushed, Adjusted teleporter spawn locations, Slightly adjusted collectable garbage bag locations, Race the Tricky Raccoon: Adjusted the failure/respawn position, Tricky Trev's Highway Race: The Flag can no longer be climbed, Adjusted the dialogue, Moved various props & fixed some floating props
[*] Hectic Highway: Moved various props. Improved boss cutscene, new collision effects, new sprint effects
[/list]

[h2]Forest[/h2]
[list]
[*] Boulder Beats: Adjusted Secret Hat Location & Hitbox, New barrier destruction effects, New Rolling Boulder Audio, New Crystal Explosion Effects & Sounds, Added a secondary music track: One will play when within the chase sections and the other plays while outside of them
[*] Frozen Forest: New VFX for Hockey Game, Rearranged/moved some props, Eagles: Chase speed increased, Edgy Eddy: New Aura, New Defeat VFX, New Collision sounds, Changed Lighting/Fog, Fixed a bug with Daring Dom's hat, New VFX for present collection game, Spell book speed decreased by 10%
[*] Magical Meadows: Improved intro cutscene, Improved Felicia Cutscene, Slightly redesigned Felicia platform area, New Collision Effects & Aura for Felicia, Decreased Fox Footstep audio, Fabulous Felicia now howls less often. Howl times are also randomized. Felicia now starts patrolling after chase sooner & also moves between waypoints more often. Changed grass colors, Adjusted some props. Apple Quest: Fixed a bug that could cause the apple to appear when the quest was already complete. Steal the Writing Instruments: Adjusted dialogue
[*] Wonderful Willows: Fixed collision issues on various platforms, New VFX for football game, Football game: New Respawn point,  New VFX on Intro Cutscene, Adjusted Teleporters, Adjusted some prop positions, fixed weird collision issues on one of the platforms
[*] Ravenous Rabbit: Improved rabbit hop effects, improved intro cutscene, Carrot pickup colliders slightly larger (making them easier to collect), Fixed a bug where sometimes rabbit collectables either were not being tracked or were being tracked incorrectly
[*] Mushroom Marsh: Decreased bloom, Moved some props, Snag the Falling Mushrooms: Increased spawn rate for mushrooms & increased number requirement, relocated one checkpoint, Minor optimization, Adjusted rain VFX
[/list]

[h2]Spooky World:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Guards now run faster.
[*] Adjusted materials on various surfaces
[*] Crazy Carnival & Silly Circus: New Tree Props, Redesigned Circus Tent, New Props Added, Changed Bushes, New Brazier Fire Effects
[*] Crazy Carnival: Bones From the Sky: Increased Drop Rates, Increased Amount Needed to Collect and Increased Game Time, Changed Audio Effects. New Fire for the Skull's eyes, Redesigned the Haunted House, New Effects on Rabbit Minigames, new minigame win & lose sounds, Fixed an audio bug and the rabbit watching minigame, Fixed an audio bug and the rabbit mimic minigame, Ryan Race: Ryan slightly slower. Fixed an issue where sometimes when Ryan won, it would still indicate Roxy as the victor
[*] Silly Circus: Fixed a bug where certain street lights couldn't be climbed, New props, Rearranged some props, New Bone Launcher minigame effects, New Whack a Rabbit Minigame effects, new minigame win & lose sounds, - increased rabbit spawn rate  Fixed an audio bug with the Whack-A-Rabbit minigame, Added 1 second to the raceway game
[*] Ghoulish Graveyard: New Victory Confetti, New Tree Props, Cauldron Ball: New Effects & Cauldron Particles - New Bounce Sound Effects - new lose sound & increased volleyball spawn rate, New Pendulum VFX, Giant Spider: New Footstep sounds & Now uses 3D Audio
[*] Nasty Necropolis: Redesigned grass scaling & placement throughout the level, New graveyard spirits, New Borus cutscenes effects, Modified environmental effects, New Borus Collision Sounds, New Borus Collision Visual Effects, Steal the Magic Rings: Fixed a problematic area in the ring quest where Roxy could get stuck in the rocks -  adjusted dialogue, Find the Witch's Hideout: Fixed an audio issue & added walking effects for the guard
[*] Tricky Traitor: Fixed a bug where the secret hat would remain visible after being collected, Improved Intro Cutscene, Improved Outro Cutscene, New Cauldron Smoke Particles, New Pumpkin trails, New Pumpkin Aura, New Wall Explosion effects, New Haunted Tree Prop, New Pumpkin Push Sounds, Moved & Resized various props, Better synchronized foot step sounds for tricky Trevor, New music
[*] Solemn Swamp: New boney bob spawn effects, New Slime Splash, Improved Intro Cutscene, optimized level, New Rolling Log Sound, New Rolling Log Collision Effects, Adjusted some prop locations, Dispel the Magic Amulet: New Aura on amulet & amulet has been recolored, Rabbit Hide & Seek: Removed a visual bug and New Victory sound

[h2]Game World:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Devious Donna Battle: Improved cutscene effects, New Coloring on Signs, New Missile: Spawns, Trails & Explosions, Fixed a bug where sometimes two missiles could be out at the same time, New Damage Effects, New Wall explosion Effects, Increased card missile speed by 20%, Adjusted the ladder heading to the second part of the battle, Fixed a bug where dying in a previously beaten area/stage of the fight would revert progress to that point
[*] Graceful Games: New Cutscene Effects, Dice within the rollers now have an effect where they float around and move randomly, Adjusted minigame spawn positions, Adjusted some domino positions making gaps easier to cross

[*] Winter Whimsy: New Spawn Stone Colors, Improved intro cutscene, New Nutcracker Models, New Christmas Tree Model, Fixed a bug that could cause snowball boulders to roll into areas they weren't supposed and sometimes bunched up in groups, New Nutcracker snowball spawn and collision effects, Slight level optimization, New present push sounds, Recolored raceway targets, Recolored Secret hat Collection VFX, Snowball catch quest: Increased snowball size making it easier to catch, rescaled some objects in the housing area which originally had an area where the player could get stuck, Snowball collect game: Fixed a tracking issue, Dodge the Snow Boulders: Fixed an issue related to the timer
[/list]

[h2]Rapid Ryan's Arcade[/h2]
[list]
[h3]Removed the following Minigames[/h3]
[*] Training Tracks, Pinchinko, Firing Frenzy, Precision  Playfield, Rolling Romp, Whack A Rabbit, Catch A Rabbit
[h3]Added the following Minigames[/h3]
[*] Daring Dasher, Gem Gatherer, Odd One Out, Orbiting Oddity, Raccoon Roller, Rough Rotations, Zig-Zag Zoom
[b]Why?[/b]
[*] The minigames were originally made to show off part of the game Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic. However, these minigames have developed and gone much further beyond in Pinball Panic that these actually may give player's a negative impression of Pinball Panic. On top of this, Pinball Panic has since gone free to play and you can access much better versions of these games for free within Pinball Panic.
[*] As a solution I replaced these minigames with other minigames better suited to the original Roxy Raccoon. The rewards and unlockables are now linked to these minigames instead.
[*] Missile Blocker: Announcer added. Fixed a score tracking bug, Adjusted the font
[/list]

[h2]Overworld[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed props, changed props & moved props.
[*] Optimized for better load times
[*] Optimized for better performance
[*] Adjusted the Displays on Treasure Chests, Added an indicator to show if the secret hat for each level was collected or not
[*] Fixed a bug where some moveable props could not be interacted with.
[*] Decreased Wild Willy & Bodacious Borus Walking sound volumes
[*] Adjusted Trevor's position in the forest world.
[*] Bodacious Borus: Fixed a bug that caused his model to sink into the ground
[*] Great Gamble's Spawn Location is now associated with the city as opposed to the Game World
[*] Added a teleporter from the pinball panic area back to the game world
[*] Added a Nappy Joe NPC to the Bowling Bash Area
[*] The ladder on the back of the truck in the manic machines area can now be climbed
[/list]

notes.title: Accessibility/Colorblind Update
notes.content:
The Following Options have been added to the video settings menu:

[h2]Colorblind Options[/h2]
[list]
[*] None -Enabled by Default
[*] Protanopia - Simulates missing red cones.
[*] Protanomaly - Simulates reduced sensitivity red cones.
[*] Deuteranopia - Simulates missing green cones.
[*] Deuteranomaly - Simulates reduced sensitivity green cones.
[*] Tritanopia - Simulates missing blue cones.
[*] Tritanomaly - Simulates reduced sensitivity blue cones.
[*] Achromatopsia - Simulates completely missing cones.
[*] Achromatomaly - Simulates reduced sensitivity of all cones
[/list]


Please note that this only impacts the gameplay camera and not the U.I.


Cheers!

notes.title: Bowling Bash Expansion
notes.content:

[b] A brand-new Bowling themed level to celebrate the launch of Bowling Bash. Along with this level, comes extra achievements & cosmetics. [/b]
[h1] Content: [/h1]
[list]
[*] This level has been added in celebration of the release of Roxy Raccoon’s Bowling Bash! It is found within the game world of the overworld and is unlocked after completing the main story.

notes.title: Ryan's Arcade Expanded!
notes.content:
[h1] Rapid Ryan’s Arcade[/h1]
[list]
[*] 2 New Arcade Games!
[*] One achievement and online leaderboard for each game.
[*] One unlockable fur & hat for each game.
[/list]

[h2] Whack-A-Rabbit[/h2]
[list]
[*] A pinball variation of Whack-A-Mole. Hit rabbits with Roxy as they pop out of the ground and before they burrow back down.
[/list]

[h2] Catch A Rabbit[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rabbits run back and forth from bush to bush. Use Roxy to catch them before they go into hiding!
[/list]

[list]
[*] The logo on the splash screen has been cleaned up.
[*] Some text on the main menu has been cleaned up.
[*] A new panel/page has been added to the guidebook in the overworld for the new Rapid Ryan’s Arcade minigames.

[*] Gameplay & Video Settings have been separated into two menus.
[/list]
[h1] Video Settings[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fog

notes.title: Rapid Ryan's Arcade Expansion
notes.content:
[h1]Rapid Ryan's Arcade:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A brand-new area has been added to the overworld with 6 different minigames!
[*] This new hub-area is accessible from the Game’s world area and is an optional area, not required to completing the main story.
[/list]

[h2]Each minigame has the following:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A target score to beat as well as collectable gems. Collecting the gems unlocks a new hat as per usual and beating the target score will unlock a fur color as well. This means one cosmetic and one fur color per minigame. That is 6 of each in total!
[*] An achievement tied to beating the target score.
[*] Online leaderboards which can be viewed from within the minigame as well as within the arcade.
[*] A "How to Play" section from the in-game pause menu.
[/list]

[h2]Pinball Panic:[/h2]
One of the more simplistic tables from the spinoff game, “Roxy Raccoon’s Pinball Panic”. This table has been added free of charge for those who may be interested in a sample.

[h2]Pin-Chinko:[/h2]
A take on a classic pachinko machine where you can manipulate the ball's movement. 

[h2]Rolling Romp:[/h2]
A take on skee-ball where you can manipulate the ball's movement and control the power of the throw with a pinball plunger.

[h2]Firing Frenzy:[/h2]
Balls continuously launch from the pinball plunger, shoot them into the various lanes for maximum points within the allotted time.

[h2]Precision Playfield:[/h2]
Balls fire one at a time from the pinball plunger,  shoot them into the various lanes for maximum points with a set number of balls.

[h2]Missile Blocker:[/h2]
[list]
[*] This was moved from the game world in the overworld into the arcade.
[*] Unlockable cosmetics/furs & online leaderboards were added to this mode to align with the other minigames.
[*] The UI was overhauled.
[/list]


[h1]General:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved lighting quality on various stages
[*]The pinball panic pinball table in the overworld was moved into Ryan's Arcade
[*]Fixed a bug where the secret hats on Manic Machines, Boulder Beats & Solemn Swamp were not being rendered.
[*]Fixed a bug where if the game is paused while the screen is shaking, it would continue to shake while paused.
[*]Fixed an audio bug on the level Pinball Panic found in Donna's game world.
[/list]
